speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for presenting with right knee swelling and a family history of similar issues. To begin our assessment, can you describe exactly how the pain started and what activities were you doing at the time?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilic Arthropathy (Hemophilia).

Given the patient's age, spontaneous right knee swelling without trauma, and the specific family history of similar issues on the maternal side (suggesting an X-linked recessive pattern), the clinical picture is highly indicative of hemophilia. We should immediately confirm this with coagulation studies. REQUEST TEST: PT, PTT, Factor VIII and IX activity levels.
